messages:
alex: Heads up — started seeing a spike in tenant T-42 reconnects after the canary. Console shows duplicate ws sessions for same client_id
maya: I see billing alerts too — per-token charges spiked ~3x. Could be retries counted as new sessions.
ryan: Do we have code that dedupes session claims on the edge? Last change touched routing lease expiry from 5s->1s.
alex: yep the lease TTL change (PR #4821) -> edge accepts new conn if lease expired. If client retries quickly it gets a new session id and double-bills.
samir: @alex can you paste the logs for a single client?
alex: logs snippet:
```
INFO session=tenant=T-42 client_id=xyz lease=2026-02-24T12:01:23Z accept new_session=abc123
WARN session=tenant=T-42 client_id=xyz old_conn=def456 lingering=true
```
lina: UI shows 2 active sessions for same client for ~8s. Is linger supposed to be immediate close? Might be gap in STOP message.
maya: Also telemetry shows reconnects considered "new_request" for quota metric. We should distinguish resume vs fresh stream.
ryan: Proposal: change routing to attempt session handoff if previous conn < 10s and same client_id, rather than accept new. Fallback to new if handshake fails.
samir: We also need to ensure console's session table uses "session_fingerprint" to dedupe — currently it's per-connection id.
alex: Quick mitigation: revert lease TTL to 5s or short-circuit billing to not double-charge when session resumed within grace window.
maya: Which is less risky? Reverting TTL or change billing?
ryan: Reverting is fastest. I can roll back the lease TTL PR in canary and patch prod if green.
lina: Add a console annotation so SRE knows this is canary related, otherwise support will get 100 pings.
samir: Also add a flag in quota pipeline: if same client_id and reconnect within 15s, mark as resume so tokens not double-counted.
alex: Will open two PRs: rollback + quota-friendly resume marker. I'll link them here.
alex: PRs: https://git/repo/pull/4950 (rollback), https://git/repo/pull/4951 (quota-marker)
maya: Nice. Also add a dashboard alert for "duplicate sessions per tenant" threshold so we catch early.
ryan: I'll coordinate rollout: revert to canary, watch metric for 10m, then roll to prod.
lina: Postmortem note: we need clearer telemetry bridging sessions <-> billing. Add to backlog.
infra-bot: Deploy started for rollback on canary cluster-3 — build 4950 at 12:45UTC.
samir: Thx. If we still see spikes after rollback, next step is implement session handoff logic.
